name: Erika Callisto
source:
(Ovine Replica) Melanie's biological sister who seems to have her own interests in mind when she appears to assist with the operations of the WASP. She seems to be on good terms with Otis.

(Ursine Science) A friendly bartender who prefers to keep her background private if she can help it. Koraki can only wonder just how this odd woman promises to use her knowledge and aid Koraki in her quest.
